RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, meaning sex was not a differentiating factor in the selection. While an all-male panel may reflect a broader lack of demographic diversity within the institution, it provides no basis for a claim of sex discrimination in choosing between two male candidates. 

Raising this would appear baseless and could harm your professional reputation. The decision appears to have hinged on candidate profiles: the bank prioritized regulatory affairs experience over your deep statistical modelling expertise. Rather than challenging the panel’s composition, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback focused purely on skill alignment and areas to strengthen for future senior roles.
